The respective provider or operator of the linked pages is always responsible for their content. Permanent monitoring of linked pages for legal violations is not reasonable without concrete evidence of an infringement. Upon becoming aware of any such violation, we will remove the relevant links without delay.
imprint.disclaimer_text: This game is for educational purposes only — to grow in Bible knowledge. No real money or prizes are awarded. Heavenly Talents are a fictional in-game currency with no real-world value.

tips.title: Game Tip
tips.tip_bible_open: Keep a Bible nearby while you play — many questions can be looked up directly!
tips.tip_bible_joker: The Bible Lifeline reveals the scripture reference for the current question — in three stages from the exact verse down to just the book.
tips.tip_entry_fee: Each game costs an entry fee of 10 % of your accumulated winnings. The more you save, the higher the stakes!
tips.tip_more_quizzes: You can download and play additional quiz sets from the Quiz Library — just tap "Choose Quiz".
tips.tip_own_quizzes: You can create your own quiz sets and share them with friends — perfect for Bible study groups or youth groups!
tips.tip_safe_haven: After question 5 (1,000 Talents) and question 10 (32,000 Talents) your prize is locked in — even if you answer wrong afterwards.
tips.tip_walkaway: You can walk away after any question and keep your current prize. Sometimes wisdom beats courage!
tips.tip_fifty_fifty: The 50:50 lifeline removes two wrong answers — great when you're torn between two options.
tips.tip_grace: The Grace of God lifeline acts randomly — it can restore another lifeline, remove a wrong answer, or even reveal the correct answer!
tips.tip_tiers: Questions get harder with each tier. From question 6 onwards a new round begins with significantly more challenging Bible questions.
tips.tip_fresh_questions: The question bank is regenerated every 24 hours — come back each day for a brand-new set of Bible questions!
tips.tip_per_quiz_winnings: Your accumulated winnings are tracked separately for each quiz — every quiz set has its own balance. That way you can play different quizzes independently.
tips.tip_study_card: After every correct answer a card appears at the top showing the Bible passage to read more about it. Tap 📖 in the toolbar to toggle it on or off at any time.
tips.tip_install: Did you know you can install this game on your phone? Just tap the share button in your browser and choose "Add to Home Screen" — then it opens like a real app, even without internet!
tips.tip_study_quiz: After your next Bible study, try turning your notes into a quiz! Writing your own questions is one of the best ways to truly absorb what you've read — and even more fun to play with friends.

rules.title: How to Play
rules.p1: Answer 15 Bible questions and win up to 1 million Heavenly Talents.
rules.p2: Tap an answer to highlight it — tap it again to confirm your choice.
rules.safe_text: After question 5 (1,000 T.) and 10 (32,000 T.) your prize is locked in — even if you answer wrong afterwards.
rules.walkaway_text: You can stop after any question and take your current winnings.

install.title: Install the App
install.checking: One moment – getting the installer ready
install.ready_text: Install "Who Wants to Be a Bible Millionaire?" right on your device – then you can start the game straight from your home screen, even without internet.
install.manual_ios: Tap the share icon in your browser bar (bottom on iPhone, top on iPad) and choose "Add to Home Screen". That's it – the game will sit right next to your other apps.
install.manual_firefox: Open your browser's menu and choose "Install" or "Add to Home screen". After that the game starts like a real app.
install.manual_safari: In the menu bar choose "File" and then "Add to Dock" (Safari 17 and newer) – the game then runs in its own window.
install.manual_other: Open your browser's menu and choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
install.already_hint: By the way: if you have already installed the game you will find it on your home screen – then you can simply close this window.
install.success_text: The game is on your home screen now. Enjoy playing – and God bless!
